_comment: Documents/evidence library. Phase 7. A single DocumentVersions row can be linked from many DocumentEvidenceLinks rows (one approved fire-safety certificate can support several controls across several frameworks at once) — this many-to-many shape is what powers the document detail page's 'Supports N records across M frameworks' summary via computeEvidenceReuseSummary() in functions/shared/pure/evidence-reuse.ts. Expiry is evaluated live from expiry_date against the current date every time a link is used as evidence (isValidEvidence() in document-rules.ts) — never cached as a stored boolean that could go stale. Documents.document_number/current_version_id/confidentiality_level/retention_period_months/status/updated_at, DocumentVersions.effective_date/change_summary, DocumentEvidenceLinks.evidence_level/purpose/page_or_section/reporting_period, and the DocumentPropertyApplicability/DocumentDepartmentApplicability many-to-many tables were added during the Phase C (documents module) Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — all were present on apps/web's Postgres schema and in active use by the documents Server Actions/UI, but missing from the original Phase 7 port.

tables.comment: The approval DECISION as its own record, mirroring the CAPAVerification/IncidentInvestigation split — who approved/rejected, when, and why, independent of the status column on DocumentVersions.

Many-to-many: one approved DocumentVersion can support many linked entities (control_assessment, kpi_definition, audit, audit_finding, capa_action, disclosure, climate_risk) and one linked entity can cite many documents. This is the table computeEvidenceReuseSummary() reads to produce 'Supports N records across M frameworks'.
